<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows seven carbon signals. The signal at 168.20 ppm is outside the aromatic region (likely a carbonyl). The remaining six signals (134.30, 131.90, 128.20, 128.20, 127.40, 127.40) fall within the typical aromatic carbon chemical shift range (≈110–160 ppm). Therefore, the molecule contains six aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
